title: Fix the launch-screen freeze
summary: Stops the selected-night date repair observer from repeatedly retriggering itself, which could keep Android and other installed PWAs stuck on the Anaesthetic Night Roster opening screen.
changes: Makes the product-owned date label update idempotent so the child-list observer does not create a self-sustaining DOM mutation loop during startup.
Keeps the 50.2 protection that removes late legacy pretty-date wrappers on Night, Changes and Breaks without starving authentication, shared-roster loading or launch recovery.
Adds a deterministic regression contract that rejects unconditional date-label rewrites inside the observed product shell.
Preserves roster calculations, staffing rules, Malta and DST timing, authentication, database writes, offline safety and clinical state colours.
